svg.title: MSCA-Dilated spatial and channel gates
svg.desc: Three independent branches use 3 × 3 convolutions with dilation rates 1, 2 and 4. Their concatenated context generates spatial weights. A separate global pooling path generates a channel weight for each of the 1024 channels. The original value F and both weight tensors are multiplied.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 5. Scientific sources: MSCA_Dilated.py, Figure 5 labels and revision 44 section 3.3. Layout references: MambaVision (CVPR 2025), Fig. 3 for separate branches and orthogonal connectors; the approved Figure 1 artwork. Native SVG shapes, text and connectors.

g.desc: Apply the energy gate to channel-wise spatial statistics of the context projection. The spatial weights retain channel, height and width dimensions.
